verdicts.reason: Both use the same reasonable left-to-right banner structure, with the quote mark, the 3-line headline and the attribution on the left and the can on the right. Both share the same flaw: the logo floats alone in the middle gap instead of anchoring a corner or grouping with anything. A: the backing circle is pushed off-centre down and to the right of the can, which reads as misplaced rather than as the original's deliberate cropped corner arc, and the can's sun icon crowds the top edge. B: centring the can on a complete circle reads as an intentional product badge and balances the right side better, though the full disc drifts from the original's corner arc and the sun icon still sits tight to the top edge.
